newsitem.title: USA: Valmont to sell unit, sees Q4 charge.
newsitem.headline: Valmont to sell unit, sees Q4 charge.

text.p: Valmont Industries Inc said Monday it had agreed to sell its lighting ballasts unit to Chicago Miniature Lamp Inc and would take a charge to after-tax earnings in the fourth quarter of $10-$11 million on the sale.
Chicago Miniature will pay about $25 million for the unit, which makes magnetic and electronic ballasts for fluorescent, sign, and HID lights.
"The transaction is subject to governmental clearances and standard closing conditions and is expected to be completed in early February 1997," the companies said in a joint statement.
Chicago Miniature makes miniature lighting products.
Valmont makes poles, towers and structures for lighting, communication and utility applications, as well as mechanized agricultural irrigation systems and other products.
